The variable is **`DEVICELOGS_AWS_ENDPOINTOVERRIDE`**. Compose sets it to `http://localstack:4566`. Inside the compose network, LocalStack is reached at `localstack:4566`, not at `localhost:4566`, which is the value in each `local-test` file. The variable maps to the property `device-logs.aws.endpoint-override`.

**The easy mistake:** writing `DEVICE_LOGS_AWS_...` with an underscore for the dash. Spring drops the dash in `device-logs` when it turns a property name into an environment variable name, so the prefix has to be `DEVICELOGS_`. The underscore version is silently ignored, so nothing fails and the service just keeps using the default endpoint.

- `local/docker-compose.yml` (lines 4, 13)
- `local/CLAUDE.md` (line 55)
- `processor/CONFIGURATION.md` (line 13)
